title: Meet the Nominees for Snapchat’s Inaugural Snappy Awards Show
summary: Today, Snapchat is excited to announce the nominees for the first-ever Snappy Awards Show. These creators embody the innovation, creativity, and influence that define Snapchat’s community across entertainment, comedy, music, sports, beauty, and beyond.
